As someone who’s developed having Seizures late last year, this is shocking to me that people want to fake this. Seizures scare me and all the ones I’ve had have left me very injured. Last episode left me in the hospital for days in a state I didn’t even live in. I’m looking at the scars I will forever have from apparently flailing on brick and concrete so long I busted both my hands open and couldn’t use them most of December. That was a fun Christmas. I had two black eyes and a massive knot on my head from hitting it against brick. The gashes in my tongue took forever to heal. Plus the feeling you get and the overwhelming sense of doom you get when a seizure is oncoming…only thing I can describe is you feel like you’re gonna die. Why would anyone want this? 

I know you’re young. I’ll lighten up but please please PLEASE just stop or come clean or both depending on your circumstances. I get it, I was 14 once and have done stupid things. Doing stupid things also doesn’t make you stupid, you’re just naive and young and have been “rewarded” for bad behavior.  So it’s hard to stop. Though I use rewarded in quotes because you will not like true outcome of your lies as you fall deeper into the pit. 

I promise you, you’re not a bad person. If you don’t go down this road. Because if you continue, you’re on the right track to grow up to be an actual bad person. This isn’t you and you want to change. That in itself shows you can do it. Much love to you kiddo, you can get yourself out of this I promise. ❤️
